title: Yellow Delight Japanese Eggs Tamagoyaki
description: A light and energizing Japanese dish from Okinawa, featuring star anise and double-rise-bread, perfect for a halal-friendly meal. This tamagoyaki recipe is a unique twist on traditional Japanese eggs.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork until the whites and yolks are fully incorporated.
Add the ground star anise, salt, and black pepper to the eggs and whisk until well combined.
Heat the melted butter in a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the cubed double-rise-bread to the pan and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes.
Pour the egg mixture over the bread in the pan and cook until the edges start to set, about 2 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the egg mixture towards the center of the pan, allowing the uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
Continue cooking and folding the egg mixture for another 4 minutes, until it is almost fully set.
Use the spatula to shape the egg mixture into a rectangular tamagoyaki shape.
Cook for an additional minute, until the egg is fully set and the tamagoyaki is lightly browned on the bottom.
Remove the tamagoyaki from the pan and serve hot.
Serve with a side of water or your favorite beverage.
